scientific_conclusion: The exact Stage-78 transverse-kinetic common-frame face/cell field is reconstructed by the fixed Stage-79 radial-shell/angular decomposition to machine precision. Radial shell 2 (speeds 2.16135 to 10.19351 in the frozen c-space rule) supplies 68.6768% of the componentwise cell-divergence absolute magnitude and 69.7871% of the face absolute magnitude; shells 1 and 2 together supply 99.9324%. The retained vertical-oblique angular sectors supply 86.5752% of the cell-divergence absolute magnitude. The dominant shell remains coherent across adjacent x faces (correlation 0.908599) but still strongly face-to-cell cancellation dominated (ratio 0.0708497). This is a reproducible localization of the frozen residual structure only; it is not an adjoint sensitivity and does not demonstrate that changing velocity quadrature or transport would improve q_av.
positive_findings: The Stage-78 dominant transverse-kinetic field is reconstructed to numerical precision from the exact Stage-67 distributions.
One retained radial shell exceeds the preregistered 50% dominance guard and the retained vertical-oblique sectors exceed the preregistered 70% concentration guard.
No cavity solver rerun or physical/numerical retuning was performed.
negative_findings: Velocity-space concentration is not an adjoint sensitivity and is not evidence that changing quadrature or transport will reduce the benchmark heat-flux error.
The failed Stage-28 MUSCL endpoint remains unrecovered and is not extended to Kn0=0.1 or Kn0=10.
No physical, collision, correction-floor, source-relaxation, transport, wall, normalization, or velocity-quadrature parameter was retuned.
